title: Runners
description: Machines that run this organization's pipeline jobs. A runner takes jobs whose runs_on labels it has.

empty.title: No runners yet
empty.manage: Register a runner so queued pipeline jobs can run.
empty.view: Ask an organization admin to register a runner.

form.name: Name
form.labelsHint: Comma-separated, e.g. linux, docker, gpu. Lowercase letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.
form.labelsInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores (start with a letter or number).
form.maxConcurrencyHint: How many jobs this runner may run at the same time (1–64).
form.concurrencyRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to 64.

register.title: Register a runner
register.description: Creates a one-time token. Labels given here are added to the ones the runner reports.

token.title: Registration token
token.body: Copy it now: it's shown once, works for one runner and expires at {{time}}.
token.socketWarning: The runner starts job containers through the Docker socket, which gives it full control of that machine's Docker. Use a machine dedicated to CI.

disable.title: Disable {{name}}?
disable.body: It stops taking new jobs. Jobs it is running now continue to the end.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: Its token stops working immediately. To use the machine again, register it with a new token.
delete.bodyRunning_one: Its token stops working immediately and the job it is running fails.
delete.bodyRunning_other: Its token stops working immediately and the {{count}} jobs it is running fail.
